messages:
emma: FYI AcmeClouds PO gateway started emitting ACKs with null `order_id` after last night's deploy. Our PO importer treats that as an invalid record and drops it.
raj: Prod or preprod?
emma: Prod. First seen at ~07:57 UTC. Looks like a fallback path for some legacy partners.
claire: Finance will reject any PO without canonical id during automated reconciliation. This could block invoice matching for a bunch of customers.
matt: Sample response in our logs:
```json
{"status":"accepted","order_id":null,"partner_ref":"ACME-2026-4578","received_at":"2026-03-21T07:57:13Z"}
```
We get 202/accepted but no unique id.
emma: Can we synthesize an id from partner_ref for ingestion as a temporary mitigation? What about duplicates?
matt: We can. Plan: deploy a small shim that sets `order_id = partner_ref` when missing and sets `metadata.po_temp=true`. Add a reconciliation CSV export so Finance can reconcile any collisions. Deployment + migration script ~1.5-2h.
claire: Finance signs off on temporary synthesis only if we: 1) include `po_temp=true`, 2) emit a reconciliation report, 3) ensure downstream accounting ignores those until cleared. I will own manual fixes.
raj: Procurement: escalate to AcmeCloud procurement and ask for an immediate patch and for them to re-emit corrected POs. Include contract clause reference.
sarah: I'll review the marketplace contract for schema guarantees and SLA around message formats. If they violated the payload schema we can request reissuance and consider remedies. Looping legal.
acme-support-bot: Ticket created: AC-9880. AcmeCloud engineering investigating payload regression. ETA 3-5 hours.
emma: Good. @matt include clear revert steps: how we migrate back to vendor `order_id` when they re-emit. Also record audit trail for every synthesized id.
matt: Migration approach: 1) tag synthesized records with `metadata.po_temp=true` and `metadata.original_partner_ref`; 2) when vendor resends with real `order_id`, update ledger record to set canonical id and clear `po_temp`; 3) produce an audit CSV of changed records; 4) add automated test to detect null `order_id` in future.
claire: Please add a ledger-level flag so our accounting exports exclude `po_temp` rows until cleared. Also need a one-off CSV for Finance containing all PO numbers that were synthesized.
matt: Will add `ledger.skip_until_confirmed = true` for po_temp entries and generate the CSV. PR will be opened in next 30m.
raj: If AcmeCloud doesn't commit to re-issuing corrected POs within business day, procurement wants to pause new Acme-cloud purchases through the marketplace until fixed.
emma: I'll escalate to their partner manager and procurement leadership and keep procurement in the loop. Ill post updates here and in #partners-status. :white_check_mark:
